answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37088 Country: Bangladesh Title: My wife dreamed that he gave birth to a child. And both of us were very happy for that Question: My wife dreamed that he gave birth to a child. And both of us were very happy for that. Would you please help me know that? Answer ID: 37088 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 453/453/M=1433) The dream is blessed. It indicates towards prosperity and blessings. Pay thanks to Allah in good and sad times and do not cross the Shariah boundary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
